Extract diagnostic information from MVBU_Stanfit object

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-diagnostics.R
diagnostic-quantities.Rd

Extract quantities that can be used to diagnose sampling behavior of the algorithms applied by Stan at the back-end of MVBeliefUpdatr. These diagnostic functions are all copied and modified from brms.

Usage

log_posterior(x, ...)

nuts_params(x, pars = NULL, ...)

rhat(x, pars = NULL, ...)

neff_ratio(x, pars = NULL, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
log_posterior(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
nuts_params(x, pars = NULL, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
rhat(x, pars = NULL, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
neff_ratio(x, pars = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws_df(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws_array(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws_matrix(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws_list(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'MVBU_Stanfit'
as_draws_rvars(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An MVBeliefUpdatr object.

...

Arguments passed to individual methods.

pars

An optional character vector of parameter names. For nuts_params these will be NUTS sampler parameter names rather than model parameters. If pars is omitted all parameters are included.

Value

Log posterior draws, NUTS sampler parameters, Rhat, or Neff ratio.

The exact form of the output depends on the method.

Details

For more details see bayesplot::bayesplot-extractors.

Examples

# \donttest{
fit <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit()
#> Warning: The largest R-hat is NA, indicating chains have not mixed.
